name: Custom Shape Ruler
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

This customizable bag chain is available in four high-quality materials to suit your preference:

 - Wooden: Durable and natural-looking, perfect for a rustic touch.

 - Transparent Acrylic: Sleek and modern with a clean, minimalistic appeal.

 - Starburst Acrylic: Sparkling design with holographic star effects for a magical look.

 - Broken Glass Acrylic: Iridescent shattered-glass pattern that catches the light beautifully.

Each ruler comes with charms in customizable shapes. The minimum charm size is 2cm, ensuring visibility and durability. Charms can include the year, symbols, or other personalized details.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:

Designed slightly longer than a standard 12 inches ruler for easy full-scale measurement.

 - Overall dimensions (LxH): 12.3 x 2 inches ~ 31.24 x5.08 cm

 - Thickness: 0.3 cm across all material types.

 

  • Printing Technology:

 - UV Printing Technology ensures crisp, vivid, and detailed imagery. Long-lasting, high-quality print that resists fading and scratches.

 - Printed on both front and back sides.

 

  • Functionality & Usage:

 - Fully functional 12-inch ruler with accurate measurements. Its smooth surface and exact measurements make it a necessary tool for use in the classroom or as a classic desk accessory.

 - Features a cut-out customizable shape for easy hanging or decoration.

 - Dual-purpose: both practical for everyday measuring and aesthetic as a keepsake or gift, it will add a dash of elegance while elevating functionality.

 

  • Ideal Gift for Any Occasion:

 - A thoughtful and customizable gift for teachers, students, coworkers, or loved ones, it becomes a memorable keepsake.

 - Suitable for birthdays, holidays, Teacher Appreciation Day, back-to-school gifts, and more.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Ruler+Custom Charms

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.2 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 

 

  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.

 

  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.

 

  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.

 

  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.

 

  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.

 

  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

 

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.

 

  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
